title: Windmill with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tower -->
  <polygon points='38,88 62,88 58,45 42,45' fill='#f4e3c1' stroke='#d9c39a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tower shading -->
  <polygon points='50,88 62,88 58,45 50,45' fill='#e6d0a4' />
  <!-- window -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='4' fill='#8fd3ff' stroke='#5fb0e0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='45' y='76' width='10' height='12' rx='3' fill='#b5793f' stroke='#8f5a28' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- base -->
  <rect x='34' y='86' width='32' height='6' rx='2' fill='#9a7b4f' stroke='#7a5e38' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- smiling face on tower -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#5a4020'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#5a4020'/>
  <path d='M44 57 Q50 62 56 57' fill='none' stroke='#5a4020' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blades hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='5' fill='#ffcf5c' stroke='#e0a92e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- four blades -->
  <g>
    <rect x='49' y='18' width='2' fill='none'/>
    <polygon points='47,45 53,45 52,18 48,18' fill='#e8452c' stroke='#c02f1a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <polygon points='47,45 53,45 52,72 48,72' fill='#3a86e8' stroke='#2563c0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <polygon points='50,43 50,47 23,46 23,44' fill='#3aa55b' stroke='#288040' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <polygon points='50,43 50,47 77,46 77,44' fill='#e8b52c' stroke='#c0941a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- hub overlay again for clarity -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='4' fill='#ffcf5c' stroke='#e0a92e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
